countries.reasoning: China is the largest stainless steel producer globally, accounting for over half of production. Data based on 2023 World Steel Association statistics, very reliable and up to date.
Indonesia is among the top stainless steel producers due to its large domestic market and recent expansion. Data from industry reports around 2023; moderately reliable.
India has significantly increased production, supported by government policy and investment. Figures from World Steel Association 2023 are dependable.
Japan remains a top producer with consistent production volumes. Data from Japanese steelmaker reports and industry sources 2023.
